stem: Customers arrive at a shop at a constant average rate of 2.3 per minute.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State another condition for the number of customers arriving per minute to have a Poisson distribution.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: It is now given that the number of customers arriving per minute has the distribution $\text{Po}(2.3)$.
parts.text: Find the probability that exactly 3 customers arrive during a 1-minute period.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Find the probability that more than 3 customers arrive during a 2-minute period.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Five 1-minute periods are chosen at random. Find the probability that no customers arrive during exactly 2 of these 5 periods.
